_comment: Solstice M0 card data - metal branch. Contract: shared/schema/card.schema.json. Names come from docs/CARDS.md SS3.1 (M0 first ten candidates) plus provisional M0 grid slots.
_note: provisional=true means: this slot is written for playability so the M0 grid is complete, while its effect / params / animation / visible feedback have NOT yet been authored per card (CARD-LIST SS3 definition). Authoring order follows P1-P4 need.

desc.zh: 一撮金屑撒在纸面上，只是把那一格的反照率抬了一点点。
desc.en: A pinch of gold dust scattered on the paper: it only lifts the albedo of that one tile.

desc.zh: 抬手一照，纸面泛出一点金属的冷白。
desc.en: Tilt a hand and the paper returns a cold metallic white.

desc.zh: 这一小片从此会自己析出一点点矿，很慢，但一直在。
desc.en: This small patch now leaches a little ore of its own: slowly, but always.

desc.zh: 岩芯顶出一段矿脉条带，土生金的第一张看得见的卡。
desc.en: A rock core pushes up a banded vein: the first visible step of earth bearing metal.

desc.zh: 把落点那一小段岩石重写成矿，石头变沉、变冷。
desc.en: Rewrite a short run of rock at the landing spot into ore: heavier, colder.

desc.zh: 立一根柱子，把这一刻写进年表。世界会记得你在这里做过什么。
desc.en: Raise a pillar and write this moment into the chronicle. The world will remember what you did here.

desc.zh: 一块沉甸甸的矿石压在纸上，四周的地力被它吸走一点。
desc.en: A heavy ore boulder presses on the paper and draws a little fertility out of the ground around it.

desc.zh: 挖开一层，断面露出矿线。挖出来的地方矮下去一点。
desc.en: Cut a layer open and the seam shows in cross-section. The cut ground sits a little lower.

desc.zh: 这一片表面不再被风雨磨平，棱角会一直在。
desc.en: This surface will not be worn smooth by wind and rain; its edges stay.

desc.zh: 一座细高的铁塔从纸里长出来，界里从此有了竖直的东西。
desc.en: A thin iron spire grows out of the paper: the realm now has something vertical in it.

desc.zh: 把地块对折一次，折痕自己就成了一道山脊。
desc.en: Fold the ground once, and the crease becomes a ridge on its own.

desc.zh: 整个界的纸板都不许再塌下去：低于水面的地方被垫到水面以上。
desc.en: No board in the realm may sag again: whatever sits below the water line is shimmed up above it.
